MRI Safety Information
The Juniper Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 25 T/m.
- Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- maximum B1+rms of 1.5 μT.
- whole-body averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg or less.
The image artifact extends approximately 10 mm from the device.
